name: Traisental

known.via: English Wikipedia "Traisental" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Austrian quality wine from approved grape varieties, tested by the state before sale. Prädikatswein and DAC wines sit within it.
Districtus Austriae Controllatus, Austria's rules for regionally typical wines. The wine must show the typical character of its area.

notes: Mostly Grüner Veltliner is grown here, made fresh for drinking young.
On the Wagram, Grüner Veltliner is a little fuller and more aromatic.

blurb.text: A wine district in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, south of Krems. Grüner Veltliner dominates at 64 percent. Traisental DAC covers Grüner Veltliner and Riesling.
